jobs.title: Pre-Sales Engineer (Mid)
jobs.description:
Present and demo Delvitech's AI optical inspection systems to customers worldwide, turning their technical needs into the right solution. Job Summary Join Delvitech's TSE team, a multidisciplinary technical team that bridges customers, Sales, Product Management and Engineering, turning complex application requirements into effective technical solutions. As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical pre-sales process with customers around the world, from understanding their requirements to delivering demonstrations, evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept for Delvitech's advanced inspection technologies, and translating field feedback into actionable input for product development. Key Responsibilities
• Prepare and deliver tailored product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops and customer visits.
• Analyze customer technical requirements and translate them into solutions based on the company's products and technologies.
• Configure and adapt standard product capabilities to address specific customer applications.
• Plan and execute technical evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept using representative customer products, samples and data.
• Prepare technical documentation, reports and supporting materials for commercial proposals.
• Provide technical training to customers and sales teams.
• Collect field feedback and translate it into functional requirements to be shared with Product Management and Engineering. Requirements
• University degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific field. Candidates with a technical diploma and relevant experience may also be considered.
• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in a pre-sales, application engineering or customer-facing technical role.
• Outstanding communication and presentation skills.
• Strong interest in machine vision and electronics manufacturing (SMT).
• Fluent English.
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30 to 40% of the time (e.g. India, Morocco, North and South America). Nice to Have
• German or Spanish.
• Thesis, internship or experience in machine vision, AOI, SMT or automation.
• Basic knowledge of image processing, AI or data analysis.
• Experience supporting proofs of concept and benchmarks.
• Knowledge of Industry 4.0, MES or industrial communication protocols.
• Experience with CRM and project management tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: System Architect (CH)
jobs.description:
Shape the architecture of Delvitech's AI optical inspection systems, connecting hardware, software and AI into one reliable platform. Department: R&D Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland, 100% on-site Reports to: Head of R&D The Opportunity Delvitech develops advanced AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) systems for electronics manufacturing. We are looking for a System Architect to strengthen the architecture and analysis of our next-generation software platform, working alongside our senior software architects. This is an individual-contributor role (no people management). Main Responsibilities
• Analyze requirements and translate them into a clear system architecture: modules, service boundaries, interfaces and data models.
• Contribute to the design of Delvitech's future software platform, from concept to production.
• Make pragmatic technology choices and stay close to the implementation (prototypes, proofs of concept, code reviews).
• Lead design and architecture reviews; raise engineering quality (testing strategy, CI/CD, performance, reliability, security).
• Work closely with hardware, machine-vision and software teams on hardware-software integration.
• Document architecture decisions and technical specifications. Requirements (Must Have)
• Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field.
• 6+ years of software engineering experience, with solid hands-on experience in system architecture and design.
• Strong skills in at least one of: C++, Java/Spring, Python.
• Experience with distributed systems / microservices, REST/OpenAPI and Linux.
• Track record of bringing complex software systems into production.
• Professional fluency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with industrial, embedded or hardware-software systems.
• Knowledge of machine vision, AOI or SMT/electronics manufacturing.
• Rust, TypeScript/React.
• Docker/Kubernetes, observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus).
• Experience integrating AI components into production software.
• Italian or German. Soft Skills Structured and analytical thinking, pragmatism, clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentoring attitude, ownership, kind, humble, friendly.

jobs.title: Quality Program Manager – Cross-Functional Projects
jobs.description:
Lead cross-functional quality projects at Delvitech, aligning teams, improving processes and turning data into measurable results. Job Summary We are looking for a Quality Program Manager to lead and coordinate cross-functional improvement initiatives involving Quality, R&D, Production, Application Engineering, HPT, IT and other functions. The role turns quality and improvement objectives into structured, measurable and executable programs with clear ownership, priorities, resources, milestones and completion criteria, combining project management, process improvement and technical coordination to improve both company processes and product performance. Key Responsibilities
• Coordinate cross-functional quality improvement programs covering business processes and the technical performance of products and systems.
• Translate high-level objectives into projects, deliverables, milestones, responsibilities and measurable success criteria.
• Work with functional managers to prioritize activities and secure the necessary resources.
• Monitor dependencies, risks, delays and open decisions, escalating when required.
• Facilitate alignment and decision making between Quality, R&D, Production, Application Engineering, HPT, IT and Management.
• Analyze processes, identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, and coordinate improvement actions.
• Define KPIs to measure the effectiveness of initiatives and ensure improvements are embedded in daily processes.
• Prepare concise management reports, risk registers and progress updates, using AI and digital tools for analysis and action tracking. Requirements
• Experience managing or coordinating technical, industrial, product or cross-functional projects.
• Strong organizational, planning and project management skills.
• Proven ability to coordinate stakeholders across functions without direct authority.
• Ability to understand technical topics and complex systems to support decision making.
• Experience in process analysis and improvement, with a structured, data-driven approach.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence or similar tools and with AI tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience in product-based, industrial or technology companies with technically complex products.
• Experience coordinating projects involving both software and hardware.
• Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or Agile.
• Experience with KPIs, dashboards or Business Intelligence tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Customer / Field Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Be the voice of Delvitech's customers in quality: analyse field issues, improve escalation processes and drive lasting fixes. Job Summary We are looking for a Customer / Field Quality Engineer to create a structured connection between issues observed at customer sites and the continuous improvement of our products, processes and Quality system. The role works closely with Application Engineering, HPT, R&D, Production and Quality, analyzing escalations, failures and complaints to identify trends and systemic causes. It does not replace operational support: it ensures that field information becomes evidence, corrective actions, product improvements, requirements, tests and reusable knowledge, and it develops the end-to-end customer issue and escalation process. Key Responsibilities
• Analyze customer complaints, escalations, field failures and recurring issues.
• Design and continuously improve an end-to-end ticketing and escalation system, from the customer through support levels L1, L2 and L3 to Quality and engineering.
• Define the information, evidence, ownership and traceability required at each stage, linking issues to serial number, configuration, software release and components.
• Identify trends and systemic issues and distinguish isolated events from issues requiring structural action.
• Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), verifying their effectiveness.
• Define and monitor Field Quality KPIs and contribute to Quality reporting for management.
• Ensure significant field issues are translated into requirements, test cases or regression tests together with R&D and validation teams.
• Turn validated solutions into knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides; use AI and data tools to classify tickets and identify patterns. Requirements
• Experience in Customer Quality, Field Quality, Application Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service or equivalent roles.
• Experience with Root Cause Analysis, corrective actions and structured problem solving.
• Strong analytical skills and ability to work with data, tickets and failure histories from multiple sources.
• Ability to design and improve ticketing, escalation and issue-management processes.
• Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Familiarity with ticketing systems and traceability tools.

jobs.title: Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Build Delvitech's internal knowledge platform with LLMs, RAG and knowledge graphs, turning company know-how into reliable AI tools. Job Summary We are looking for a Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer to design and develop a company-wide knowledge infrastructure that collects, organizes and connects information from different sources, systems and people, and makes it usable by people, software and AI systems. The infrastructure must represent our product as a cyber-physical system, connecting software, electronics, mechanics, components, configurations, calibrations, requirements, tests, failures and procedures, in the correct context of each product, version and configuration. It will support requirements definition, software development, impact analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, training and decision making. Key Responsibilities
• Define the architecture and technical roadmap of the company knowledge infrastructure.
• Design a structured knowledge model of products, subsystems, components, configurations, software, requirements, tests, calibrations, failures and procedures.
• Integrate sources such as Confluence, Jira, GitHub, technical databases and documentation, including engineering data such as BOMs and hardware revisions.
• Design retrieval, semantic search and grounding systems based on verifiable company sources, evaluating RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases and ontologies.
• Make knowledge securely accessible to AI tools, internal applications and coding assistants, with appropriate access and permission levels.
• Design AI applications for technical troubleshooting and AI workflows to capture and validate knowledge from experts.
• Implement human-in-the-loop validation, safeguards against hallucination, data leakage and prompt injection, and metrics for accuracy and usefulness.
• Collaborate with Quality, R&D, Application Engineering, Production and Technical Writing, avoiding dependency on a single AI vendor. Requirements
• Strong ability to design and develop complex software systems integrating data, AI and services.
• Practical experience with AI, Large Language Models or knowledge management solutions.
• Good knowledge of APIs, databases and system integration.
• Knowledge of RAG, semantic retrieval, grounding and knowledge graph principles.
• Ability to model complex technical domains and cyber-physical products.
• Good understanding of LLM risks and of access control and permissioning principles.
• Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; ability to work with subject-matter experts.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with RAG, knowledge graphs, vector databases, semantic search or agentic workflows.
• Familiarity with MCP or equivalent protocols.
• Experience integrating Jira, Confluence, GitHub or enterprise platforms.
• Familiarity with Systems Engineering, SysML, PLM or BOM data.
• Experience with AI evaluation, observability and monitoring. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Capture expert know-how and turn it into clear, structured technical content for Delvitech's AI inspection machines and knowledge base. Job Summary We are looking for a Technical Writer & Knowledge Content Specialist to transform complex technical knowledge into clear, structured, maintainable and reusable content for customers, Application Engineering, Production, R&D and other functions. The role goes beyond writing standalone documents: it builds and maintains a structured technical content system, connected to product knowledge and designed to be used by both people and AI tools, in close collaboration with technical experts and the Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer. Key Responsibilities
• Create and improve technical manuals, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting guides, operating procedures, application notes and training materials.
• Transform information from R&D, Production, Application Engineering and other experts into clear and accurate content for each audience.
• Organize documentation into modular content, define templates, editorial standards and terminology, and link content to machine models, configurations and software releases.
• Define review, approval, versioning and publication processes, and keep documentation updated with product and process changes.
• Turn resolved field issues into reusable troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles, and support production and inspection instructions.
• Support multilingual content with consistent terminology.
• Structure documentation so it can be used effectively by search systems, knowledge bases and AI agents.
• Use AI daily for drafts, summaries, restructuring, translation and gap detection, always verifying technical accuracy. Requirements
• Excellent technical writing and synthesis skills, with the ability to simplify complex subjects.
• Experience creating and managing technical documentation, procedures, manuals or knowledge content.
• Ability to interview subject-matter experts and clarify ambiguities.
• Good understanding of structured documentation, content life cycle, versioning and governance.
• Strong familiarity with Generative AI tools and the ability to validate their output critically.
• Strong attention to accuracy and terminology consistency.
• Excellent written English. Nice to Have
• Experience with documentation for industrial machines, complex software, machine vision or integrated hardware and software systems.
• Familiarity with Confluence, Markdown, Git, documentation-as-code or knowledge management systems.
• Experience with structured authoring or single-source publishing tools.
• Experience creating videos, diagrams or interactive training content. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Production & Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Drive quality across Delvitech's production and suppliers: map processes, solve root causes and raise the standard of every machine we build. Job Summary We are looking for a Production & Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure the quality, stability and reproducibility of the production processes, components and assemblies used in our machines. The role works closely with Production, R&D, Supply Chain and suppliers to prevent and reduce sources of variability, developing control processes, acceptance criteria, measurement methods and common production standards that are objective, repeatable and consistent across suppliers and production sites. Key Responsibilities
• Analyze production and assembly processes, identifying variability, critical points and improvement opportunities.
• Define and improve process controls, acceptance criteria and verification methods, including clear and measurable machine acceptance criteria.
• Identify, with Engineering and R&D, the critical characteristics and parameters that affect final machine performance.
• Define and maintain Incoming Quality controls for critical components and assemblies.
• Develop Supplier Quality activities, monitor supplier performance and support the qualification of new suppliers, components and processes.
• Manage internal and supplier non-conformities, coordinating Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions and verifying their effectiveness.
• Analyze defects, rework, scrap and production data, using statistical methods to assess process stability and capability.
• Maintain Control Plans, checklists, inspection instructions and production records, and define Production and Supplier Quality KPIs.
• Align Quality processes across production sites, including production in India, together with the local Quality team.
• Use AI and data analysis tools to support non-conformity analysis, trend detection and reporting. Requirements
• Experience in Production Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrialization or equivalent technical roles.
• Strong ability to analyze, map and optimize production processes.
• Experience with non-conformities, Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions.
• Ability to define acceptance criteria and control methods based on objective measurements.
• Ability to read technical drawings, specifications and tolerances.
• Good understanding of statistical process analysis and production variability.
• Practical, structured and data-driven approach; ability to work with operators, engineers, Supply Chain and suppliers.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with products integrating mechanics, electronics, optics, motion control and software.
• Familiarity with FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Lean or Six Sigma.
• Experience with supplier audits, qualification or development, including international suppliers.
• Experience with ERP, MES, traceability systems or Business Intelligence tools. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Safeguard the quality of Delvitech's AI inspection products from requirements to release, through validation, traceability and change control. Job Summary We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer to ensure that requirements, validation activities and product changes are managed through structured, traceable and evidence-based processes. The role works closely with R&D, Testing, DevOps, Production, Application Engineering and Quality across software, embedded software and firmware, electronics, hardware, mechanics and system-level changes. It does not replace R&D ownership of technical design and validation: its objective is to ensure clear Quality criteria, traceability, verifiable evidence, complete documentation and adequate readiness before a change is introduced into the product. Key Responsibilities
• Define and maintain, together with R&D, the Quality framework for requirements, validation, product changes and releases.
• Define minimum criteria for requirement quality, so that requirements are clear, verifiable, traceable and consistent.
• Verify traceability between requirements, design, implementation, testing, validation evidence and releases, and identify gaps.
• Define release and change readiness criteria and Quality gates across product development.
• Verify that, before a release or change, the required evidence and documentation are complete and that Production, Application Engineering and customer-facing functions are informed and prepared.
• Participate in design, release and change reviews, providing an independent assessment of the available evidence.
• Ensure that hardware, mechanical, electronic and embedded changes are correctly managed in terms of revisions, configurations and compatibility.
• Monitor quality trends such as escaped defects, regressions, requirement and validation gaps and field feedback, and define related KPIs.
• Collaborate with Field Quality, Testing, Production & Supplier Quality, the Technical Writer and the Knowledge Systems & AI Engineer.
• Use AI and digital tools to support requirement reviews, traceability analysis and evidence consolidation, keeping human validation of critical decisions. Requirements
• Experience in Product Quality, Software Quality, Validation, Requirements Engineering, System Engineering, Testing or equivalent roles.
• Good understanding of the development life cycle of a technical product, from requirements to validation and release.
• Ability to work across software, embedded, electronics, hardware and mechanics projects without necessarily being a specialist in each discipline.
• Good understanding of traceability, verification and validation principles.
• Ability to assess the readiness of a release or product change, including documentation, communication and impact on other functions.
• Structured, evidence-based approach and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Familiarity with requirements, issue, test, change or documentation management tools and with AI tools.
• Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience in product-based, industrial, automation or machine-building companies.
• Experience with release governance, engineering change management or product quality assurance.
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, PLM or test management systems.
• Familiarity with risk-based testing, regression testing or readiness assessment. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Warehouse Coordinator
jobs.description:
Lead Delvitech's warehouse team: coordinate stock, inventory and material flows for the production of our high-precision inspection machines. Job Summary The Warehouse Coordinator will lead and organize the daily activities of the warehouse team supporting the production of Delvitech's AI-based optical inspection machines. The role ensures that goods receipt, storage, picking, packing and shipping are carried out efficiently and safely, and that high-value precision mechanical, optical and electronic components are handled, stored and traced with the utmost care. The Warehouse Coordinator is responsible for stock accuracy, inventory control and the correct registration of stock movements in the company ERP system, working closely with Production, Purchasing and Logistics to guarantee material availability. Key Responsibilities
• Team coordination: plan, organize and supervise the daily work of the warehouse team.
• Goods flow: oversee the receipt, storage, picking, packing and shipment of materials, components and finished machines.
• Handling of precision components: ensure that precision mechanical, optical and electronic components are inspected at receipt, stored and handled according to the required standards (e.g. ESD protection, protective packaging, controlled storage).
• Inventory control: organize regular stock counts and ensure inventory accuracy.
• ERP management: ensure that goods receipts, shipments and stock movements are correctly registered in the ERP system.
• Traceability: define and maintain storage locations, labeling and traceability of all materials, including serial numbers and component revisions.
• Material availability: coordinate with Production and Purchasing to guarantee a smooth flow of materials and support the management of shortages.
• KPIs and continuous improvement: monitor warehouse performance indicators and propose improvements to layout, processes and safety. Requirements
• 3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse operations, including the coordination of a team.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment for precision mechanics, machinery, automation, electronics or similar high-tech products is required.
• Experience in handling high-value and sensitive components (precision mechanical, optical or electronic parts).
• Good knowledge of ERP systems for stock management.
• Solid understanding of inventory control, traceability and warehouse organization.
• Leadership, organizational and communication skills.
• Attention to detail and ability to manage priorities. Nice to Have
• Knowledge of Progel.
• Experience with warehouse KPIs and layout optimization.
• Knowledge of ESD handling rules.
• Knowledge of English. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Warehouse Operator
jobs.description:
Join Delvitech's warehouse in Ticino: handle goods receipt, packing, forklift operations and stock movements for our production. Job Summary The Warehouse Operator will be responsible for the daily handling of goods, including loading and unloading materials, unpacking incoming items and packing goods for internal or external shipment. The role includes managing warehouse locations, performing inventory control and registering stock movements in the company ERP system. The operator will collaborate with production, purchasing and logistics teams to ensure material availability and efficient warehouse operations. Key Responsibilities
• Goods handling: load and unload incoming and outgoing goods using forklifts or other equipment.
• Unpacking and packing: unpack incoming materials, check for damage and sort goods by type and destination; pack finished goods or components safely for internal use or shipping.
• Warehouse management: organize storage locations and maintain a clean and safe warehouse environment.
• Inventory control: conduct regular stock counts and monitor inventory accuracy.
• ERP usage: register goods receipts, shipments and stock movements in the ERP system.
• Material identification: ensure proper labeling and traceability of all stored materials.
• Coordination: collaborate with production and purchasing to ensure a smooth material flow.
• Continuous improvement: propose improvements to warehouse layout, inventory accuracy and packing efficiency. Requirements
• High school diploma or equivalent technical background.
• Proven experience in warehouse operations, including packing, unpacking and material handling.
• Familiarity with ERP systems for stock management (knowledge of Progel is a plus).
• Understanding of inventory principles and warehouse organization.
• Attention to detail, good organizational skills and ability to work autonomously.
• Team player with effective communication skills.
• Good computer skills.
• Basic knowledge of English. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Precision Vision System Assembler
jobs.description:
Assemble and calibrate high-precision vision systems for Delvitech's AI inspection technology, working with optics, cameras and mechanics. Job Summary The Precision Vision System Assembler will be responsible for the assembly of high-precision systems, including mechanical assemblies, cameras, optical lenses, and cable routing and fastening. The role involves assembly, calibration, testing and reporting activities. The assembler will also be responsible for the complete assembly and integration of vision systems and will support the preparation and maintenance of assembly-related documentation. Key Responsibilities
• Assembly: perform high-precision assemblies, including precision fittings and custom subassemblies.
• Calibration: calibrate optical lenses and vision systems using dedicated software tools.
• Wiring and tubing: route and connect cables and pneumatic tubes required for the correct operation of the optical systems.
• Testing: perform functional testing on electronic boards and micro-assemblies.
• Documentation: support the creation and updating of assembly procedures and calibration reports.
• Collaboration: work closely with engineering and production teams to ensure compliance with quality and performance standards.
• Support: provide feedback on mechanical design and suggest improvements to increase assembly efficiency and reliability. Requirements
• Degree, technical diploma or equivalent technical background in Mechanical Engineering or related technical fields.
• Proven experience in precision mechanical assembly.
• Strong skills in the use of mechanical measurement instruments (e.g. micrometers, dial indicators, torque wrenches).
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and assembly documentation.
• Basic understanding of mechanical calibration and alignment principles.
• Problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Basic knowledge of English is a plus. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

• Installation and commissioning: install and commission our systems at customer sites and verify their correct operation.
• Configuration: set up and optimize inspection programs according to the customer's products and processes.
• Troubleshooting: diagnose and resolve technical, software and application issues, both on site and remotely.
• Training: train operators and technical staff on the use of the system.
• Service: carry out the maintenance, upgrade and verification activities required throughout the system's life cycle.
• Documentation and escalation: document all activities performed and involve the internal team when an issue requires further analysis or technical escalation. Requirements
• Technical diploma in electronics or a related field is preferred; candidates who have gained equivalent skills through experience in the installation, commissioning or servicing of industrial equipment will also be considered. A university degree is not required.
• Ability to diagnose faults, use technical instruments and explain technical issues and solutions clearly to customers.
• Willingness to travel internationally approximately 30 to 40% of the time, according to installations and service needs.
• Customer orientation, strong communication skills and a well-organized, independent working style.
• Good knowledge of English. Nice to Have
• Experience with SMT processes or industrial inspection systems. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Build and run the CI/CD pipelines, containers and releases that power Delvitech's AI inspection software, from development to the customer site. Job Summary As a DevOps Engineer, you will support the development and deployment life cycle of our software platform, built on a microservices architecture. You will maintain CI/CD pipelines, manage containerized environments and help streamline the release, update and support of our software at customer sites. We currently use TeamCity for continuous integration, Git (Bitbucket) for version control and Docker Compose for container orchestration. Our infrastructure runs on Linux (Debian/Ubuntu). Key Responsibilities
• Maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity).
• Support containerized service development and deployment with Docker/Docker Compose, including private Docker image registries.
• Build installation packages (.deb or similar).
• Administer Linux systems (Debian/Ubuntu).
• Manage the release, update and support of software installed at customer sites (on-premise), including in isolated networks.
• Apply Linux and container security fundamentals: secrets, privileges, network security.
• Support the deployment and testing of software on physical AOI systems.
• Contribute to continuous improvements in automation, scalability and reliability. Requirements
• At least 3 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, SRE or System Engineer.
• Linux administration (Debian/Ubuntu): systemd, networking, permissions, apt, etc.
• Experience with Docker/Docker Compose and virtualization tools.
• Building installation packages (.deb or similar).
• CI/CD tools (TeamCity or similar).
• Git (Bitbucket).
• Scripting in Bash and/or Python.
• Private Docker image registries.
• Linux and container security fundamentals: secrets, privileges, network security.
• gRPC and MQTT.
• Managing software installed at customer sites (on-premise): release, update and support, including in isolated networks.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to explain technical choices to non-technical people.
• Data-driven approach and ability to drive change.
• Teamwork.
• Fluent Italian and technical English. Nice to Have
• Containers with NVIDIA GPUs.
• Databases: MariaDB, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO.
• Java (Spring Boot) and Go.
• Jira and Confluence. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer / Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the web interfaces of Delvitech's AI inspection software with React and TypeScript, making complex data simple for our users. Job Summary We are looking for a Frontend Developer / Frontend Engineer with solid experience in React and TypeScript to develop modern, high-performance and well-structured interfaces for Delvitech's AI-based optical inspection software. Key Responsibilities
• Develop modern, high-performance user interfaces with React and TypeScript.
• Design reusable components and manage application performance (memoization, code splitting).
• Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs and handle asynchronous data.
• Collaborate with design, back-end and QA teams in a cross-functional environment.
• Pay attention to UX/UI details and performance. Requirements
• Solid experience with React.js: hooks, component design and performance management.
• Advanced TypeScript: typing, generics, interfaces and API/prop typing.
• Experience with at least one state management library (e.g. Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil or similar).
• Experience consuming REST and GraphQL APIs and handling asynchronous data.
• Familiarity with modern build tools (Vite, Webpack) and Git.
• Autonomy, problem-solving skills and strong collaboration skills. Nice to Have
• MUI (Material UI) component library and design system.
• Three.js for 3D/WebGL rendering.
• XState for state management with finite state machines and statecharts. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.description:
Develop the back-end and distributed services of Delvitech's AI inspection platform in C++, Java and Python, running on Windows and Linux. Job Summary We are looking for a highly skilled Back-end Software Engineer to join our R&D team. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of programming principles for production systems and experience in designing and implementing field software solutions across various platforms. Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement field software solutions using modern C++, Java and Python for Windows and Linux platforms.
• Play a key role in defining the design, implementation and testing of software components for distributed systems.
• Collaborate within a multidisciplinary development team to deliver products efficiently.

• Contribute innovative ideas to address business and customer challenges.
• Drive improvements in team working practices to ensure high standards of quality and efficiency.

• Support products throughout their life cycle. Requirements
• Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
• Excellent understanding of programming principles for production systems.
• Strong experience with C++, Java and Python.
• Familiarity with databases such as MariaDB, Redis and MongoDB.
• Experience with microservices architecture.
• Knowledge of CI/CD practices (TeamCity) and version control (Bitbucket, Git).
• High proficiency in spoken and written English.
• Ability to work in a multidisciplinary team with Electrical, Electronic, Optical and Software engineers. Nice to Have
• Knowledge of JavaScript and React.
• Experience with the Atlassian platform.
• Understanding of embedded systems programming.
• Knowledge of GPU programming.
• Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary Delvitech stands at the forefront of technological advancement, having pioneered innovative Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI) technology for assembled printed circuit boards (PCB) utilizing artificial intelligence. Our accomplished team is driven by a commitment to pushing technological boundaries and consistently delivering exceptional results. We are looking for a Junior AI Engineer to join our R&D team. The ideal candidate has a good academic or practical background in AI (mostly applied to computer vision applications), image processing, and a genuine interest in software engineering. The candidate will be responsible for developing end-to-end applications, from data collection and model training through to deployment. Key Responsibilities
• Develop and integrate computer vision or AI components into our production software.
• Write clean, maintainable and tested code, working closely with senior engineers on design and code reviews.
• Contribute to the implementation, testing and evaluation of image processing and AI solutions for defect detection and classification. Education
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another relevant scientific discipline. Requirements
• Software engineering fundamentals: Python, object-oriented programming (preferably Java or a similar language), clean code, version control (Git).
• University, thesis or personal projects in at least one of these areas: computer vision (e.g. OpenCV, image processing), or AI (e.g. deep learning with PyTorch). Nice to Have
• Experience with 3D modeling and 3D reconstruction. What We Offer You will join a young and highly technical R&D team, building production software that brings machine vision, computer vision and AI into industrial inspection systems. If you are a passionate software engineer looking for a challenging opportunity to develop innovative machine vision and AI solutions, we would love to hear from you. Delvitech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Application Engineer – Mechanical
jobs.description:
Bring mechanical expertise to Delvitech's AI inspection machines: alignment, calibration and troubleshooting with customers and our R&D team. Job Summary The Application Engineer R&D ensures structured technical support for the Application Engineers in the field, while managing escalation processes, training programs and knowledge consolidation. The role acts as the operational interface between Field Applications, R&D and the PMO, with full ownership of product operational readiness across both software and hardware domains, and ensures clear and structured communication of software and hardware releases to all relevant stakeholders. This position is for a profile with a mechanical or mechatronic background. Key Responsibilities
• Field support and escalation: manage technical escalations from Application Engineers through Jira workflows, perform technical triage, classify issues by root cause and coordinate with R&D to resolve them.
• Installations: support complex installations and troubleshooting activities.
• Hardware and system ownership: own the operational knowledge and support processes related to product hardware, act as reference point for hardware-related issues and field feedback, and ensure alignment between hardware and software behavior at system level.
• Release communication: coordinate and communicate software and hardware releases to Application Engineering, PMO, Sales and Operations, ensuring release notes are clear, complete and aligned, and support deployment readiness in the field.
• Training: develop and maintain technical training programs for Application Engineers, deliver onboarding and advanced product training, and improve their competency framework.
• Knowledge management: maintain the product knowledge base in Confluence, document troubleshooting guides and best practices, and consolidate field cases and lessons learned. Requirements
• Degree or diploma in Mechanical or Mechatronic Engineering.
• Ability to read mechanical drawings and tolerances; experience with 3D CAD (SolidWorks or equivalent).
• Experience in mechanical troubleshooting and alignment.
• Experience in technical support or application engineering.
• Ability to deliver technical training.
• Structured problem solving and cross-functional coordination skills.
• Fluent English. Nice to Have
• Experience with machine vision, AOI, automatic machines, conveyors or linear motion.
• Calibration of optical or mechanical systems.
• Experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.
• Italian or German. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
Design the industrial HMI and data-rich interfaces of Delvitech's AI inspection software, making complex workflows simple on the line. Job Summary Design the user experience and interfaces of Delvitech's AOI (Automatic Optical Inspection) software, making complex inspection workflows simple and efficient for machine operators, process engineers and our Application teams. The role goes beyond generic software design: it covers the industrial HMI used on production lines and the visualization of inspection data, working closely with our AI, software and Application Engineering teams and with real users in the field. Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland, 100% on-site. Reports to the Product Team lead. Key Responsibilities
• Design the industrial HMI of our machines, with attention to operator ergonomics, touch screen use, response times and usability in production environments.
• Design data-heavy interfaces: high-resolution images, heatmaps, quality KPIs, production statistics, defect classification and trend analysis.
• Work with the AI and Application Engineering teams to represent defects, false positives, algorithm results, warnings and classification scores clearly.
• Observe operators on production lines, take part in customer installations and training sessions, and collect real feedback during FAT and SAT.
• Create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI designs.
• Define and maintain a design system and UI guidelines.
• Work closely with front-end and software developers through implementation.
• Run usability tests and drive continuous improvement. Requirements
• At least 3 years of experience as a UI/UX or Product Designer, with a portfolio.
• Experience designing industrial HMI, SCADA or software for automatic machines and production environments.
• Strong skills in data visualization and information design (dashboards, technical data and image visualization).
• Proficiency in Figma or equivalent and in prototyping.
• Willingness to work in the field with operators and customers.
• Professional fluency in English. Nice to Have
• Experience with B2B technical products or industrial software.
• Basic front-end knowledge (HTML, CSS, React).
• Experience designing interfaces for computer vision or AI-based products.
• Italian or German. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About us Delvitech develops and builds AI-based optical inspection systems. Our machines combine precision motion, electronics and software. The role We are looking for a person with a background in electrical and electronic engineering and an interest in designing automatic machines, to join our Robotics R&D team. You will work with the team on the development and verification of electrical solutions, covering design activities, prototype testing and documentation. Autonomy will grow with your skills. We also consider candidates with initial experience, internships or relevant technical projects. What you will do
• Help design and update electrical schematics, panels and on-machine wiring.
• Contribute to the selection of power supplies, protections, cables and connectors, together with the team's designers.
• Support the integration and testing of drives, motors, encoders, sensors and I/O.
• Take part in prototype assembly and commissioning, carry out measurements and tests and document the results.
• Update bills of materials, cable lists and schematic revisions according to department procedures.
• Work with mechanics, software, Quality, Industrialization and Production to identify and solve technical issues. What we are looking for
• Degree or technical diploma in electrical, electronic, automation or mechatronics engineering, or equivalent training.
• Ability to read electrical schematics and basic knowledge of electrical engineering and electronics.
• First experience with an electrical CAD, also gained during studies, an internship or a practical project.
• Familiarity with electrical measurements and willingness to work on prototypes and real machines.
• Accurate documentation, teamwork, Italian for daily work and understanding of technical English. Nice to have
• Knowledge of SOLIDWORKS Electrical, Eplan or similar tools.
• Hands-on experience with motors, sensors, PLC or automation systems.
• Participation in automation, robotics, prototyping or machine building projects. We want to know what you have built and how you approach a technical problem. You do not need to have all the specialist skills already: tasks will be assigned based on your background and experience. Architecture, safety and compliance choices are shared and reviewed with the team leads.

jobs.title: Firmware Embedded Developer
jobs.description:
Develop the firmware of Delvitech's embedded vision systems, working in C/C++ and Linux close to the hardware of our AI inspection machines. Job Summary We are looking for a Firmware Embedded Developer with hardware skills to join the Embedded team in our R&D department. The role requires strong programming skills and expertise in machine vision, image processing and embedded computing, with a patient, organized and problem-solving approach. Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland, 100% on-site. Key Responsibilities
• Develop and optimize firmware and software for embedded systems using C/C++ and Python.
• Work with Linux-based environments, focusing on system performance and efficiency.
• Develop and integrate device drivers for microcontrollers and embedded platforms.
• Optimize memory usage and handle cross-compilation for embedded architectures.
• Conduct debugging and memory leak analysis to ensure system stability.
• Work with U-Boot, Linux Kernel, kernel drivers and Device Trees to enhance system functionality.
• Collaborate with R&D teams on machine vision and image processing solutions.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to system architecture discussions.
• Work on real-time video acquisition, analysis, recording and streaming. Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.
• At least 3 years of experience in firmware and software development for embedded systems.
• Strong proficiency in Linux, C/C++ programming and microcontrollers; good knowledge of Python.
• Experience with device drivers and memory optimization.
• Knowledge of cross-compiling for embedded systems.
• Competence in real-time video acquisition, analysis, recording and streaming.
• Experience with version control systems (Git).
• Advanced English, written and spoken. Nice to Have
• Experience with U-Boot, Linux Kernel, kernel drivers and Device Trees.
• Experience with ARM processors in Linux environments.
• Expertise in memory leak analysis and performance tuning.
• Familiarity with Rust for embedded development. Soft Skills Strong problem solving, creativity in approaching technical challenges, teamwork, clear communication, a proactive and results-oriented approach, passion for technology and strong planning skills. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer - Robotics (CH)
jobs.description:
Design mechanical parts and assemblies in 3D CAD for Delvitech's robotics and AI inspection systems, from concept to production drawings. Job Summary The Mechanical Designer will join our Mechanical Engineering Office and contribute to the creation, update and management of the technical documentation for automatic machines and industrial inspection systems. The role works closely with Engineering, R&D, Production and Supply Chain, supporting product industrialization and the resolution of technical issues. Key Responsibilities
• Create and update 3D models, assemblies and 2D production drawings of mechanical components and groups.
• Develop the technical documentation required for the production and assembly of our machines.
• Manage and keep mechanical bills of materials up to date.
• Correctly apply dimensional and geometric tolerances, fits, surface finishes, treatments and welding specifications.
• Ensure consistency between 3D models, 2D drawings, bills of materials and machine configurations.
• Modify existing components and assemblies through the engineering change process.
• Support product industrialization, improving manufacturability, ease of assembly, reliability, maintainability and cost.
• Work with Production and Quality on non-conformities and on issues found during assembly and testing.
• Support Supply Chain and suppliers in evaluating machining, materials, treatments and production solutions.
• Collaborate with R&D in transferring projects from prototype to production.
• Contribute to assembly instructions, operating procedures and company technical standards. Requirements
• Technical diploma in mechanics or mechatronics, or equivalent qualification.
• Preferably 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role; candidates with less experience but solid technical preparation, strong CAD skills and motivation to grow will also be considered.
• Experience in 3D CAD modeling and 2D technical drawings, with good knowledge of SolidWorks or equivalent.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings.
• Knowledge of dimensional and geometric tolerances, fits and functional dimensioning.
• Basic knowledge of materials and surface and heat treatments.
• Familiarity with machining, sheet metal work and production processes.
• Ability to manage assemblies, configurations and bills of materials.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.
• English sufficient to understand technical documentation and communicate with suppliers. Nice to Have
• Experience in the design or documentation of automatic machines.
• Experience with PDM/PLM systems and ERP software.
• Knowledge of the Machinery Directive and safety-oriented design criteria.
• Experience with engineering changes, non-conformities and production documentation.
• Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing and Design for Assembly principles. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: General Assembler (CH)
jobs.description:
Join our production team in Ticino and assemble Delvitech's AI inspection machines, handling mechanical assembly and electrical wiring. Job Summary The General Assembler will be responsible for carrying out standard mechanical and electrical assembly activities within the production department. The role includes assembling kits and basic mechanical components, installing sheet metal parts, routing and connecting cables, and completing general machine assembly tasks according to drawings, instructions and production procedures. Key Responsibilities
• General assembly: assemble standard kits, components and mechanical subassemblies.
• Mechanical assembly: perform basic mechanical assembly activities using standard tools and equipment.
• Sheet metal assembly: install covers, panels, brackets and other sheet metal parts.
• Cable routing: route, position and secure cables according to assembly instructions.
• Cable connection: connect electrical cables, sensors and standard components following defined procedures.
• Documentation: follow assembly drawings, work instructions, checklists and production documentation.
• Quality control: perform basic visual and functional checks during assembly.
• Collaboration: work with production and technical teams to ensure correct assembly and material flow.
• Continuous improvement: provide feedback and suggest improvements to assembly methods and work instructions. Requirements
• Technical diploma or equivalent background.
• Previous experience in mechanical or electrical assembly is preferred.
• Basic ability to read mechanical drawings, assembly instructions and wiring documentation.
• Familiarity with standard hand tools and assembly equipment.
• Basic knowledge of cable routing and electrical connections.
• Good manual skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to follow procedures and work instructions accurately.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Basic knowledge of English is a plus. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: IT Support & Information Security Specialist (CH)
jobs.description:
Keep Delvitech's people productive and secure: manage Microsoft 365, devices and networks, and strengthen our information security. Job Summary We are looking for an IT Support & Information Security Specialist to keep Delvitech's IT environment reliable and secure. You will support colleagues in their daily work, manage Microsoft 365, devices and networks, and help strengthen our information security, including the path towards ISO/IEC 27001. Location: Mendrisio, Switzerland, 100% on-site. Key Responsibilities
• Provide day to day IT support to colleagues through helpdesk and ticketing.
• Administer Windows and macOS clients, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD).
• Manage networks (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi), endpoint security, patching and backups.
• Manage user access and MFA, applying information security best practices.
• Support the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001 controls together with the relevant teams. Requirements
• Windows/macOS client administration.
• Microsoft 365 & Entra ID (Azure AD).
• Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi).
• Helpdesk & ticketing.
• Endpoint security, patching & backup.
• Information security basics (access management, MFA, ISO/IEC 27001 awareness).
• Fluent English. Nice to Have
• Intune / MDM.
• Firewall administration.
• Supporting ISO/IEC 27001 implementation.
• PowerShell or Python scripting.
• Virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V).
• Certifications (CompTIA A+/Security+, Microsoft 365).
• IEC 62443 awareness. Soft Skills Service orientation, reliability, confidentiality, problem solving and communication. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Calibration Technician (CH)
jobs.description:
Calibrate and test Delvitech's AI optical inspection machines before delivery, combining mechanics, PLC configuration and software. Job Summary The Calibration Technician will be responsible for the setup, calibration, testing and validation of our AOI machines in production, using mechanical tools, measurement instruments and the machine's dedicated software running on Ubuntu. The technician will work closely with the Quality department and, when needed, with R&D. The role also includes drafting production documentation, such as test reports, checklists and updates to calibration procedures, and completing the final checklist required to approve the shipment of machines to customers worldwide. Key Responsibilities
• Configuration: manage the basic machine configuration, including control PLC, safety PLC and PC (Ubuntu).
• Machine calibration: perform manual calibrations using mechanical tools and software calibrations using dedicated tools.
• Testing and validation: execute electrical safety tests, ESD tests, functional tests and product validation.
• Troubleshooting: diagnose, report and resolve identified issues.
• Documentation: support the creation and updating of production and calibration procedures.
• Reporting: complete reports, documentation and test results.
• Collaboration: work closely with teams outside production, such as Quality, Application Engineering and R&D.
• Cross-functional operations: perform assembly tasks when needed, particularly on optical vision systems, to meet production targets. Requirements
• Technical diploma or degree in engineering, IT or a related field.
• Knowledge of the Linux environment (Ubuntu).
• Strong computer skills.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Good command of English. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Buyer
jobs.description:
Source the mechanical and electronic components behind Delvitech's AI inspection machines, managing suppliers, RFQs and orders in ERP. Job Summary The Supply Chain Buyer will play a key role in ensuring the timely and cost-effective procurement of the materials and components required to support production. The role includes managing purchase orders, supplier follow-up, delivery monitoring, sourcing activities and purchasing data within the ERP system. This position requires strong organizational, negotiation and supply chain skills. Previous experience in purchasing mechanical parts, electronic components and/or PCBs will be considered a strong plus. Key Responsibilities
• Purchasing: manage purchase orders, supplier follow-up and order tracking.
• Supplier management: maintain relationships with suppliers and follow up on pricing, lead times, availability and delivery performance.
• RFQ and sourcing: request and compare quotations and support supplier selection based on cost, quality, lead time and reliability.
• Material availability: ensure material availability according to production needs and support the management of shortages and critical components.
• Master data management: maintain accurate purchasing data in the ERP system (suppliers, prices, lead times and purchasing conditions).
• Supplier quality and returns: support supplier non-conformities, returns, replacements and related follow-up activities.
• KPI and reporting: prepare reports and KPIs on supplier performance, purchasing activities and material availability.
• Process improvement: support procurement process optimization and contribute to internal purchasing and supplier management procedures.
• Audit and compliance support: assist during internal and external audits (e.g. ISO, quality standards). Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 2 to 4 years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain or similar roles.
• Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent).
• Understanding of purchasing processes, supplier management, lead times and material availability.
• Experience in purchasing mechanical and electronic components.
• Analytical mindset with strong organizational, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
• Team player with effective communication across departments and with suppliers.
• Proficiency in English, written and spoken. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.

jobs.title: Mechanical Precision Assembler
jobs.description:
Assemble and align the precision mechanics of Delvitech's AI inspection machines, from linear motion systems to final mechanical setup. Job Summary The Mechanical Precision Assembler will be responsible for the assembly of high-precision mechanical systems, including linear motors, guides and motion components. The role involves mechanical alignment, precision measurements and mechanical calibration activities. The assembler will also handle the integration of conveyor systems and support the drafting of assembly-related documentation. Key Responsibilities
• Mechanical assembly: perform high-precision mechanical assemblies, including linear motion systems and custom subassemblies.
• Alignment and calibration: align linear motors and mechanical guides using appropriate measuring tools and techniques.
• Installation: assemble conveyor systems and integrate them into the machine framework.
• Measurement: use tools such as dial indicators and micrometers for precision setup.
• Documentation: assist in drafting and updating assembly procedures and calibration reports.
• Collaboration: work closely with the engineering and production teams to meet quality and performance standards.
• Support: provide feedback on mechanical design and suggest improvements for assembly efficiency and reliability. Requirements
• Degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical background.
• Proven experience in precision mechanical assembly.
• Strong skills in the use of mechanical measurement instruments (e.g. micrometers, dial indicators, torque wrenches).
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and assembly documentation.
• Experience with linear motion components (e.g. linear motors, ball screws, linear guides).
• Basic understanding of mechanical calibration and alignment principles.
• Problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Basic knowledge of English is a plus. What We Offer A permanent position in a fast-growing technology company that develops its own AI-based optical inspection systems, with strong opportunities for professional growth as the company expands.
